description:
Team HELIOS (Solo)

How do you get continuous, high-resolution astrometry of the atmosphere without spending millions on dedicated hardware?

 Building AEGIS: A gamified citizen-science network for global astrophotography. It uses a rolling 4-day temporal window and overlapping land nodes to continuous 3D atmospheric visuals. By incentivizing local photographers and routing around clouds and light pollution, we create a self-monitoring planetary sensor built on gamified community engagement.
